title: Recursive finite scheme refinement trees
statement: For schemes W and T [def-pc-scheme], an immersion t:T → W and a predicate allowed on a vertex and its two child morphisms, define a finite refinement tree recursively. A tip records T as quasi-compact and quasi-separated and t as an immersion. A node records the same properties at T, an open immersion l:L → T and closed immersion r:R → T [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion], both quasi-compact, with complementary images, an allowed split, and refinement trees over the structural maps l followed by t and r followed by t. AllLeaves P means P holds at every tip. Bind replaces each tip with a supplied refinement tree; AllLeaves predicates are preserved by bind when they are preserved by each replacement, and are monotone under implication.

proof.text: Define the inductive tree by its tip and node constructors. Define AllLeaves and bind by recursion. Prove preservation under bind and monotonicity by induction on the original tree.
